d: Estranged sisters Sharon and Tracey accidentally meet at a book signing with complicated results.
Jen fakes her way into a job at Reynholm Industries.
Matt agreed to an arranged marriage in order to save the family business, but when he suddenly falls for Sara, he must choose between duty and love.
A knight returning from the Crusades takes on a dragon and becomes a legend.
Doug is left heartbroken when his girlfriend Susan calls off their relationship. One day, he comes across an injured duck and decides to take it to a vet, who he starts developing feelings for.

Small-town girl Lucy Jacobs has started her freshman year at a big-city university. When she returns home for Thanksgiving break, she suspects that she's about to get turkey dropped: dumped by her high-school sweetheart.
